module.name: QUALI-D Remote Agent
module.description: Allow call center agents to receive FreePBX calls from anywhere in the world — including countries where SIP port 5060 is blocked (e.g. Egypt) — via the QUALI-D cloud SIP relay. All traffic runs over port 443. Simply enter your QUALI-D API key and the module configures everything automatically: SIP trunk, dialplan rules, and agent credentials.

changelog.version: Initial release — auto-provisioning, agent management, WSS trunk
